nota: decide 9-nov: 'stock sinks' (1.004, momentum 3.74). Detras: Nvidia -4.27% el 9-nov mientras el S&P 500 sube 2.35% y el Dow 1,104 puntos. El termino es un QUE: el explainer es la concentracion del indice (Nvidia ~6% del S&P 500). Noticia con estructura 'error comun' (turno 2 del calendario; midterm-rally, noticia, es el mejor medido: 1.00). No se cuenta el asunto personal del CEO: solo 'board opened an investigation into its CEO' (CNBC, Al Jazeera). Fuentes leidas: Motley Fool 9-nov (cierres), CNBC 9-nov, Al Jazeera 9-nov; peso ~6%: titular MarketWatch/Yahoo 9-nov.

frases.texto: Monday, the stock market soared. A giant inside your index fund sank.
Nvidia fell four percent after its board opened an investigation into its own CEO.
Your fund still had a great day.
An index fund protects you from one company, right?
Not quite. Nvidia alone is over six percent of the S and P five hundred.
That's over six cents of every dollar on one company.
That weight lifted your fund on the way up.
It pulls the same way down, and one headline is enough.
Nobody knows how the investigation ends, and one day proves nothing.
An index fund spreads your money. It just doesn't spread it evenly.
Your index fund had a great Monday. Its biggest worry had a terrible one.
Nvidia fell four percent after its board opened an investigation into its own CEO.
The same day, the rest of the market soared.
But Nvidia is over six percent of the S and P five hundred.
That's over six cents of every dollar on one company.
That weight lifted your fund on the way up.
It pulls the same way down, and one headline is enough.
Nobody knows how the investigation ends, and one day proves nothing.
A great Monday for your fund. And a reminder of how much of it is one stock.
